name: Portrait Hero
tag: Your photo up top, the day under it
why: Opens on your portrait fading into sage with the greeting over it, then Next up, Film Mode, and the run sheet as a clean list. Photos on the blocks and deals keep it alive. Closest to the Soft Sage you picked, now with a face.

name: Timeline
tag: The day as a rail with photo stops
why: A vertical time rail runs down the left with a photo at each stop, so you see the whole day as a path, where you are, and what is done. The current block is open with its to-dos. Best for feeling the shape of the day at a glance.

name: Photo Tiles
tag: Four big photo doors, Apple Fitness style
why: Home is four tall photo tiles: Film, Pipeline, Content, Week, each with its live number on it, like the Fitness and Journal apps. Tap a tile to enter. Under them, Next up and the run sheet. The most visual of the five, and the fastest to navigate by thumb.

name: Focus Strip
tag: One big now card, a photo strip of what is next
why: The Now card is huge with the block photo behind it and one button. Under it a horizontal strip of the next blocks as photo cards you swipe through, then money and waiting. Fewer things on screen, more air, still everything one tap away.

name: Magazine Sage
tag: Big type, a photo mosaic, a filmstrip of your reels
why: A light Montserrat greeting over a mosaic of your travel photos, the run sheet as a numbered list with hairlines, and the content pipeline as a filmstrip of real post thumbnails. Looks like a travel magazine issue about your day. Most on-brand with the website.
